Rendered by one GPU Fuse, so it plays at 24 fps.

items.description: Blob tracking graphics: tracks bright, dark, edges, motion or a color, then draws boxes, coordinate labels, dashed connections, trails and inset fills.

items.description: Magic Mask cutouts with Print Lab V2 looks: print plate, two-ink riso, torn paper cutout, color pop and a tiled Ground backdrop that follows the subject, with motion, shadow and outline.

items.name: Tracker Lab | G&G
items.description: One tracker for the Edit page: track a point or a flat surface, then attach text, shapes or media (with a 3D plane), stabilize, or patch things out with clone, frame, blur or pixelate. Planar pins graphics to a surface or replaces a screen, with Surface 3D for true perspective. Replaces Tracker Pro, Locked On and Patch Up.

launcher.notes: OutPost gets its own app icon and a refined wordmark, in the same family as EDTLB, MTNLB, OFFLD and FLCKS.

setup.name: DaVinci Resolve Studio
setup.tagline: Blackmagic Design · edit, color, Fusion and Fairlight
setup.description: The current Studio release, straight from Blackmagic. Runs Blackmagic's own installer, which asks for your admin password and shows the licence. Your Studio key or dongle carries over.

setup.name: Frame.io Drive
setup.tagline: Adobe · Frame.io projects as a drive on your Mac
setup.description: Mounts the team's Frame.io projects in Finder so camera cards, cuts and reviews are one folder away. Replaces Frame.io Transfer. Downloaded from Adobe's own update feed and checked against their checksum.

setup.name: Gyroflow
setup.description: The desktop app for stabilising footage from camera gyro data. Universal build from the Gyroflow project on GitHub, GPL-3.0.

setup.name: Gyroflow OFX
setup.description: Gyroflow inside Resolve: apply a stabilisation project to a clip in the Edit or Color page. The current plugin from the Gyroflow plugins project, signed by Gyroflow. Lands in the system OFX folder, one admin prompt. Restart Resolve after installing.
